The '''Point of Parting''' was a structure in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Plaeree/Legends|Plaeree]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. Attached to the city's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the structure served as a plaza where explorers leaving the planet could meet with their families before departing. Over time, major spaceports on the planet incorporated their own Point of Parting into their facilities. A cultural trend that the residents of Plaeree began in their city's ancient past, the validity of this assertion was never established as anything more than a local legend.<ref name="NoP" />
